subject: Pre-board briefing: narrative spine, open data asks, and risk log
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Park <danielle@obsidian.vc>, BoardOps Rook <board_ops@rookcap.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-board briefing: narrative spine, open data asks, and risk log

Team —

Attached is a first-pass pre-board outline (preboard_outline_v1.pptx). High level goals for this thread: lock the narrative spine, surface any material open data asks we need from Product/Infra, and capture items that must go into a risk appendix.

Please review the following asks and reply inline by COB Monday (3/15):
- Narrative spine: cover -> highlights -> KPIs -> risks -> asks. I put suggested slide owners in the notes.
- KPIs: I flagged three slides that need up-to-date tables: ARR movement, model latency/cost delta (hosted vs dedicated), and activation funnel. Marcus, can you confirm the activation cohort snapshot and share updated CSV?
- Risk appendix: we need a 1-pager on audit readiness and an explicit note about fallback model behavior in case of degraded performance. Neha, would legal/security be able to draft the audit readiness blurb?
- External comms: Danielle — this is early; any immediate red flags?

Key constraints: the chair wants a 6-slide executive summary (1x highlights, 1x metric snapshot, 1x product momentum, 1x ops/risk, 1x asks, 1x appendix pointer). We will expand the appendix for the board package.

Attachments: preboard_outline_v1.pptx (outline + speaker notes), kpimetrics_table.csv (placeholder table).

Thanks — I know this is tight. I will assemble the consolidated draft on Tuesday afternoon.

—
Tessa Morgan
Head of Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Park <danielle@obsidian.vc>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-board briefing: narrative spine, open data asks, and risk log

Tessa —

Thanks for the outline. I attached a quick risk appendix draft (risk_appendix_draft.docx) with three initial items: SOC 2 status, data retention policy & KMS posture, and last incident summary (Feb 2027 cache evictions). A few notes:

- SOC 2: we are in final evidence collection; legal wants to avoid hard dates in the board deck. Suggest language: "audit program underway; evidence collection in progress; estimated completion Q3 2027 (subject to external auditor schedule)".
- Data retention/KMS: product should provide the current retention table. If that table is included, we need to ensure it is approved by Security for public board distribution.
- Incident summary: we should keep it high-level and include mitigation actions only. I flagged a short timeline (one slide).

One ask on metrics: the model latency/cost delta slide currently compares hosted vs dedicated in an early experiment window. That experiment included small batch sizes; it inflates the latency number. Can we re-run with steady-state batching? Marcus / Product infra should own that redo.

I can take the risk slide and the legal-approved blurb if Marcus shares the finalized retention grid by Monday noon.

-Neha
Chief Compliance Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-board briefing: narrative spine, open data asks, and risk log

Quick editorial pass from me —

- Narrative: tighten the opening paragraph to call out 3 things the board should walk away with (growth traction, unit economics improvement, and risk posture). I made inline notes on slides 1–3.
- Data appendix: let's put the full tables in the appendix but show only the delta callouts in the six-slide summary.
- Slide owners: Marcus for KPI tables, Neha for risk slide, Tessa for the asks slide, Soojin for the narrative/flow.

I also recommend we capture a 1-liner on OKR progress: quarterly red/amber/green snapshot (we can embed this as an appendix callout). Marcus, can you add a single line per objective with % complete by EOD Monday?

Thanks — small items but will make the deck scannable.

—
Soojin Lee
Director, Communications & Content
Redwood Inference
From: Danielle Park <danielle@obsidian.vc>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: BoardOps Rook <board_ops@rookcap.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-board briefing: narrative spine, open data asks, and risk log

Tessa / Neha —

Thanks for sharing. A couple quick reactions from Obsidian's side:

1) Executive summary: please make explicit the magnitude of cost improvements from the performance optimizations you reference. High-level %s are fine, but the board will want a sense of recurring run-rate impact.
2) Risks: keep the incident summary factual; avoid technical jargon. The goal is to communicate operational resiliency and time to full mitigation.
3) Asks: if you plan to request budget flexibility for Dedicated, signal the amount and the timeline now so the board can consider it in advance.

Availability: I can join a 30-min slot Tue 3/16 9:00–10:00 PT or Wed 3/17 11:30–12:00 PT for a quick run-through.

—
Danielle Park
Partner, Obsidian VC
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Park <danielle@obsidian.vc>, BoardOps Rook <board_ops@rookcap.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-board briefing: narrative spine, open data asks, and risk log

Thanks all — consolidation below and action checklist. I will produce deck v1 (6-slide summary + appendix) on Tue morning and share for final pass.

Consolidation / owners / due dates: 
- KPI tables: Marcus to upload kpimetrics_table.csv with cohort snapshots + activation line by Mon 3/15 12:00 PT (Marcus action: confirm).
- Model latency/cost delta: Marcus/Infra to re-run experiment with steady-state batching; deliver numbers + short method note by Tue 3/16 10:00 PT.
- Risk appendix: Neha will finalize legal-approved blurb and incident timeline by Tue 3/16 12:00 PT.
- Narrative & executive summary: Soojin will provide tightened 3-line executive narrative and slide copy by Tue 3/16 09:00 PT.
- Asks & budget: I will propose the Dedicated budget ask and timeline; will share numbers in v1. Danielle — noted your request to signal amount.

Meeting for run-through: Danielle available Tue 3/16 9:00–10:00 PT — let's book 9:00. I will send a calendar invite once deck v1 is posted.

Attachments being tracked: preboard_outline_v1.pptx, kpimetrics_table.csv, risk_appendix_draft.docx.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. If anything slips, flag immediately so we can triage scope (appendix vs summary).

—
Tessa Morgan
Head of Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference
